review.notes: Full review. All eight findings of the previous review are repaired (R05 but for two residues, R07 where named). Six P3 findings: undefined ED.k labels, backticked own names absent from Suggested.lean (ED1.DistanceWitness and four others; contradicts one sentence of the description), nine targets as bold run-in paragraphs cited as sections, restated/implementation paragraphs after proofs, four locators, damaged sentences. Seeded sample of 15 targets read against 12 fetched sources (24 locators, 20 agree); headline statements checked against the suppliers' matveev and yu and recomputed by brute force for the four classical lists (545/514 S-unit solutions, 72 Thue-Mahler tuples, Thue quartics, integral points, triangular numbers). Gate passes (all counters 0, build 0); Suggested.lean elaborates with twelve sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe leaves all twelve theorems open; depcheck 0 problems. Not read in full: roughly Layers 2, 5 and the tables of 6.18-6.35 outside the sample were scanned mechanically (per-section Checks, Needs, locators, identifiers, internal references), not line by line. Not verifiable: matveev2000 not read, yu1994 displays missing from its text. The sources service created a sources.toml for this package while fetching; it was removed again, since a review edits no manifest.
